findings.description: Every finding candidate produced by this lens. Use an empty list only when no contract-affecting finding exists.

target.description: The artifact, file, section, or behavior being criticized.

evidence_anchor.description: The concrete evidence location supporting the claim.

what.description: Plain description of the observed problem.

why.description: Why the evidence supports the claim and why it matters.

upstream_evidence_required.description: True when the finding needs evidence outside the current allowed boundary.

severity_hint.description: Non-authoritative lens severity hint. Use blocker/high/medium only when materiality_basis and causal_path are evidence-backed.

materiality_basis.description: Required object for blocker/high/medium candidates; null for clear low/info surface findings.

affected_purpose.description: The declared purpose or contract weakened by this finding.

failure_condition.description: The bounded condition where the declared purpose fails or trust is weakened.

impact.description: Why this changes review trust or actionability for the declared purpose.

causal_path.description: Required object for blocker/high/medium candidates; null for clear low/info surface findings.

root_cause_candidate.description: Evidence-backed starting cause candidate, not a severity label.

steps.description: Causal chain from observed surface finding toward the starting cause.

relation_to_previous.description: null for the first surface step; otherwise how this step relates to the prior step.

evidence_refs.description: Concrete refs supporting this causal step.

unresolved_beyond_evidence.description: Boundary-limited uncertainty beyond the evidence, or null when closed enough.

domain_constraints_used.description: Domain rule provenance actually used by this lens. Use [] when session_domain is none or no domain rule was used.

source_version_or_snapshot_id.description: Version or snapshot id for the source document.

anchor.description: Stable section anchor within the source document.

domain_context_assumptions.description: Informal domain/context assumptions used by this lens. Use [] when none were used.

no_findings_rationale.description: Always submit this field. Use an empty string when findings is non-empty; when findings is empty, explain why this lens produced no finding.
